name: @mcp-access-stack/update-control-worker
description: Independent read-only MCP Update Control Worker.

scripts.check: npm run build --workspace @mcp-access-stack/edge-protocol && npm run build --workspace @mcp-access-stack/mcp-owner-auth && npm run build --workspace @mcp-access-stack/update-control-contract && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && wrangler deploy --cwd ../.. --config services/update-control-worker/wrangler.jsonc --dry-run --outdir services/update-control-worker/.wrangler/dry-run --var "MCP_UPDATE_CONTROL_OAUTH_REPROVISION_URL:https://update-control-ops.example/_operations/oauth/reprovision" --var "MCP_UPDATE_CONTROL_OAUTH_REPROVISION_ACCESS_ISSUER:https://test-team.cloudflareaccess.com" --var "MCP_UPDATE_CONTROL_OAUTH_REPROVISION_ACCESS_AUDIENCE:test-update-control-audience"
